terms.title: Terms of Use
terms.intro: These Terms of Use ("Terms") are an agreement between you and notlike.us ("notlike.us," "we," "us"). By creating an account or using the notlike.us app (the "Service"), you agree to these Terms and to our Privacy Policy. If you do not agree, do not use the Service.

sections.heading: 1. Who can use notlike.us
body: You must be at least 18 years old to use the Service. Couple accounts require both partners to be 18 or older. Group accounts must be created by an organizer who is 18 or older and who agrees that everyone attending notlike.us meetups with the group is 18 or older.
You may not use the Service if you have been convicted of a violent or sexual offense, if we have previously removed you, or if using it would break any law that applies to you.
You agree to give truthful information, including your age, and to keep your account secure. You are responsible for everything that happens under your account.

sections.heading: 2. What notlike.us is, and is not
body: notlike.us introduces people from different backgrounds for friendship and conversation. It is not a dating service.

We do not conduct criminal background checks, identity verification, or screening of members, and we do not verify the statements members make. We cannot guarantee anyone’s identity, intentions, or conduct.

sections.heading: 3. Your safety and meetups
body: You are solely responsible for your interactions with other members, online and in person. Use good judgment: meet in public places, tell someone where you are going, arrange your own transportation, and leave any situation that feels unsafe.
Any meetup, event, or activity you arrange is arranged by you and the other members, not by notlike.us. We are not responsible for what happens at, on the way to, or after any meetup.
If you are ever in danger, contact local emergency services first. Then report the member in the app.

sections.heading: 4. Rules of conduct
body: Treat other members with respect. You agree not to: harass, threaten, demean, or discriminate against anyone; post nudity, sexual content, violence, or hate symbols; impersonate anyone or misrepresent your age; solicit money, sell products, or recruit for any business, cause, or religion against a member’s wishes; share another member’s personal information without their permission; or use the Service for anything unlawful.
Learning about each other’s faiths and beliefs is welcome. Pressuring someone to change theirs is not.

sections.heading: 5. Your content
body: You keep ownership of the photos, profile information, and messages you submit ("Your Content"). You give us a non-exclusive, worldwide, royalty-free license to host, store, display, and process Your Content only to operate, improve, and protect the Service.
You confirm you have the right to share Your Content, including permission from everyone who appears in your photos.
Photos are checked automatically and may be reviewed by a person before other members can see them. We may remove any content or account at our discretion, with or without notice.

sections.heading: 6. Ending your account
body: You can delete your account at any time in the app under Your answers → Delete my account. We may suspend or end your access at any time, for any reason, including for breaking these Terms.

sections.heading: 7. No warranties
body: THE SERVICE IS PROVIDED "AS IS" AND "AS AVAILABLE," WITHOUT WARRANTIES OF ANY KIND, EXPRESS OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING ANY IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY, FITNESS FOR A PARTICULAR PURPOSE, TITLE, AND NON-INFRINGEMENT. WE DO NOT WARRANT THAT THE SERVICE WILL BE UNINTERRUPTED, SECURE, OR ERROR-FREE, OR THAT ANY MEMBER IS WHO THEY CLAIM TO BE.

sections.heading: 8. Limitation of liability
body: TO THE FULLEST EXTENT ALLOWED BY LAW, NOTLIKE.US AND ITS OWNERS, VOLUNTEERS, AND PARTNERS WILL NOT BE LIABLE FOR ANY INDIRECT, INCIDENTAL, SPECIAL, CONSEQUENTIAL, OR PUNITIVE DAMAGES, OR FOR ANY DAMAGES ARISING FROM YOUR CONDUCT OR ANY OTHER MEMBER’S CONDUCT, ONLINE OR OFFLINE. OUR TOTAL LIABILITY FOR ANY CLAIM WILL NOT EXCEED THE GREATER OF THE AMOUNT YOU PAID US IN THE PAST 12 MONTHS OR US$50.
Some places do not allow certain of these limits, so they may not all apply to you.

sections.heading: 9. Indemnification
body: You agree to defend, indemnify, and hold harmless notlike.us and its owners, volunteers, and partners from any claims, losses, liabilities, damages, and expenses (including reasonable attorneys’ fees) arising from your use of the Service, Your Content, your interactions with other members, or your breach of these Terms.

sections.heading: 10. General
body: These Terms are governed by the laws of the State of California, without regard to its conflict-of-law rules. Any dispute will be resolved in the state or federal courts located in Los Angeles County, California.

We may update these Terms. If the changes are significant, we will tell you in the app, and continuing to use the Service means you accept them. If any part of these Terms is unenforceable, the rest still applies.
Questions: support@notlike.us

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: This policy explains what notlike.us collects, why, who can see it, and the choices you have. The short version: you decide what to share, skipped questions are never stored, we never sell your information, and you can delete your account at any time.

sections.heading: What we collect
body: Account: the email address or Sign in with Apple identifier you use to sign in. If you use Apple’s “Hide My Email,” we only receive a private relay address.
Age: we ask for your birthday only to confirm you are 18 or older. We do not store your birthday, only that the check was passed.
Profile: your account type (single, couple, or group), name or group name, gender if you choose to give it, photo, short bio, general area, and interests.

Background answers: your answers about faith or worldview, race, cultural background, home language, where you grew up, the household you grew up in, education, income, sexual orientation, disability, activity level, body type, relationship status, children, military service, generation, political outlook, political party, how much politics matters to you, and work, plus your gender if you give it. Many of these are sensitive. Every one is optional, and “Skip” or “Prefer not to say” answers are never stored.

Private answers: your answers about race, sexual orientation, disability, income, and body type are private unless you choose “Show this answer on my profile.” A private answer is stored so you can change it later, but no other member can see it, and it is not used for matching.
Activity: who you said hello to or passed on, your matches, your messages, and any reports or blocks you make.
Technical: basic device and app information needed to run and fix the app, such as app version and error reports. We do not collect your precise location.

sections.heading: How we use it
body: To create your account and confirm you are an adult; to show you people who are different from you and show them to you; to display how you differ on match cards; to deliver messages; to check photos for inappropriate content; to keep members safe, investigate reports, and enforce our Terms; and to fix and improve the app.
We do not sell or rent your information, we do not show ads, and we do not share your information with advertisers.

sections.heading: Who can see what
body: Other members can see your profile: name or group name, photo, general area, bio, interests, and the background answers you chose to give and show, which appear as differences on match cards. They never see your private answers.
Your hellos and passes are private. No member is ever told who passed on them, and nobody learns about your hello unless they say hello too.
Messages can only be seen by you and the person you matched with, and by us if a conversation is reported or we must investigate a safety issue.

sections.heading: Service providers
body: We use a small number of companies to run notlike.us, and they may process your information only on our behalf: Supabase (secure database, sign-in, and photo storage, hosted in the United States), Expo (app delivery and updates), Apple (Sign in with Apple and app distribution), an email delivery service (sign-in codes), and an image-checking service (automatic photo safety checks).
We may also disclose information if required by law, or to protect someone’s safety.

sections.heading: How long we keep it
body: We keep your information while your account is active. When you delete your account, your profile, photo, answers, hellos, matches, and messages are deleted within 30 days. We may keep a minimal record of a report or a removal for safety reasons, for example to stop a banned person from returning.

sections.heading: Your choices and rights
body: You can change or remove any answer, change your photo, block or report anyone, and delete your account in the app at any time.

Depending on where you live (including California), you may have the right to know what we hold about you, get a copy, correct it, delete it, and limit how sensitive information is used. We only use sensitive information to provide the Service. To make a request, email us. We will not treat you differently for using these rights.

sections.heading: Security
body: Information is encrypted in transit, and database rules make sure members can only reach what they are allowed to see. No system is perfectly secure, so please share only what you are comfortable sharing.

sections.heading: Children
body: notlike.us is only for adults 18 and older. We do not knowingly collect information from anyone under 18. If we learn that we have, we delete it.

sections.heading: Changes and contact
body: If we change this policy in a significant way, we will tell you in the app first.
Questions or requests: support@notlike.us
